reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it promotes CashKaro's ordinary cashback and referral program, explaining that users share a referral link and receive a stated percentage of referred users' shopping cashback. Although it uses optimistic income examples such as ₹10,000 or ₹15,000 per month, the observed participation path is a conventional shopping-based referral promotion with no request for payment, existing credentials, private keys, or account control.

citations.quote: Cashcaro is India's biggest cashback website where you can purchase through here.
you earn a fair 10% of their cashback their whole life
You spread out your referral link like this and get as many people as possible on your site and you'll also earn a lot of real cash which can be transferred on your bank account.
If you dont have cashkaro account , there is a signup link in the description.

opening.argument: The reward is presented as the direct consequence of taking a registration and referral action, not as an ordinary discount alone. Viewers are sent to a signup link, asked to create an account with personal login details, and told that signup produces a cash bonus. The same funnel then promises recurring earnings after distributing the referral link. That is a low-barrier cash-acquisition pitch in which clicking, registering, and recruiting are tied to money claims, while the conditions for receiving those amounts are left largely unexplained.

citations.quote: If you dont have cashkaro account , there is a signup link in the description. You can click that.
you can earn 25 rupees as real sign up bonus
you can set your name, email id, and password number, to create
You spread out your referral link like this and get as many people as possible on your site and you'll also earn a lot of real cash which can be transferred on your bank account.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this a conventional cashback program does not answer the solicitation being made. The cited 10% figure describes the proposed reward, but does not establish that the advertised ₹10,000 or ₹15,000 outcomes are realistic or that the signup and referral conditions are fully disclosed. Showing shopping brands likewise does not validate the cash claims or the promised signup bonus.

citations.quote: you earn a fair 10% of their cashback their whole life
you will earn Rs 15000 a month without any hassle

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The registration path does not itself make the offer a scam: the described benefit is connected to shopping cashback, and the program is not presented as requiring a payment or account transfer. The quoted signup bonus and referral earnings show promotional terms, but they do not show that users lose money, that the service is fake, or that the claims are impossible. The argument treats ordinary account creation and link sharing as inherently deceptive.

citations.quote: Cashcaro is India's biggest cashback website where you can purchase through here.
you earn a fair 10% of their cashback their whole life
you can earn 25 rupees as real sign up bonus

opening.argument: The presentation combines unusually large returns with unusually little effort and a direct social-sharing pathway. It says viewers can earn ₹15,000 monthly “without any hassle,” while the title advertises ₹5,000 on every referral and the example scales earnings through many contacts. The promotion also directs viewers to links in the description and encourages distribution across messaging and social platforms. Taken together, these are classic low-friction reward signals: an attractive cash outcome, simple actions, and an external acquisition path, with no meaningful demonstration that the advertised figures are typical or guaranteed.

send your referral link and with that, also write your message for people and tell them the benefits of creating an account

rebuttal.rebuttal: The fact that cashback can arise from shopping does not resolve the exaggerated framing. The reference account highlights the mechanism but leaves the unusually high examples and “without any hassle” claim untouched. A list of sites and a referral percentage can coexist with a misleading promise about likely earnings; ordinary branding is not evidence that the headline returns are substantiated.

citations.quote: Cashcaro is India's biggest cashback website where you can purchase through here.

you earn a fair 10% of their cashback their whole life

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The optimistic examples are explicitly tied to referred users shopping and generating cashback, rather than to a free payment for doing nothing. The presence of a link and social-sharing instructions is normal for a referral promotion, and the evidence does not show a required deposit, fabricated withdrawal, or guaranteed return. Large illustrative earnings may be aggressive advertising, but that alone does not establish scam conduct.

opening.argument: Although packaged as an explanation of how referral systems work, the video functions as an active recruitment promotion. It supplies a referral link, tells viewers to compose a persuasive message, and urges them to reach as many people as possible. The income example is built around sending the offer to 200 people and creating a referral network, so the core activity is not merely learning about cashback; it is recruiting participants whose activity generates commissions. The instructional format therefore acts as the participation funnel.

they come under your referral network
send your referral link and with that, also write your message for people and tell them the benefits of creating an account
get as many people as possible on your site and you'll also earn a lot of real cash

rebuttal.rebuttal: Describing this as ordinary commerce understates what viewers are being asked to do. The cited shopping function explains what recruits may do, but the video's own instructions emphasize contacting large numbers of people and building a referral network. The link, message template, and earnings calculation make recruitment the actionable centerpiece, not incidental education about discounts.

citations.quote: they come under your referral network
if you send the referral link to 200
click on my account icon & click on refer and earn here you will see your referral link

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The promotional role is undisputed, but promotion is not proof of a prohibited recruitment structure. The stated commission is a percentage of referred users' cashback, and the evidence describes shopping through participating sites rather than payment for joining, downline qualification, or a tiered matrix. A referral network and social sharing can describe a one-level customer referral program without establishing scam mechanics.
